content: Audit finding record: stable finding ID (F-001), title, severity (CVSS base adjusted for exposure/asset criticality/compensating controls), affected asset and exact file paths, plain-English description, evidence (request excerpt, scan output, screenshot, log), reproduction steps another practitioner can follow, recommended remediation, and a validation/retest criterion. No closure without retest or formal documented risk acceptance. Uniform structure per finding across the report.
